description:
Select and place a dental implant at the lower right first molar site (tooth #30) using Blue Sky Plan. 

Goal: Maximize the implant length while strictly maintaining a minimum 2.0 mm safety distance from the inferior alveolar nerve canal.

Steps:
1. Open the loaded mandibular case.
2. Navigate to site #30.
3. Identify and trace/mark the inferior alveolar nerve canal.
4. Measure the vertical bone height from the ridge crest to the top of the nerve canal.
5. Select the longest standard implant that fits while leaving >= 2.0mm safety gap.
6. Place the implant.
7. Place a measurement ruler showing the final distance between the implant apex and the nerve.
8. Save a screenshot of the cross-section showing the implant, nerve, and measurement to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\implant_safety_check.png'.
9. Save a text file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\implant_plan_data.txt' with the format:
   Available_Bone_Height_mm: [value]
   Selected_Implant_Length_mm: [value]
   Final_Safety_Gap_mm: [value]
